notes: Raw inputs for made items. A made item's cost is the sum of quantity times these prices, with waste_high applied to the high end. Snapshot prices come from search results and may be undated or stale. Placeholders are guesses. Unpriced inputs count as $0 and make the item unpriced.

pla_per_kg.note: 5 kg spools: SUNLU at $54.99 on sale is about $10.99 per kg. MatterHackers at $99.99 is about $20 per kg. Matter3D and Kingroon sit between, at about $13 to $14 per kg. Shipping extra.

petg_per_kg.note: Not searched. Guess only. Replace with a bulk PETG price before trusting printed frames.

fr4_single_sided_per_cm2.note: Single-sided copper-clad FR4 only. Low: Newark's 100 x 160 mm board at $1.43. High: Mouser's 3 x 5 in board at $10.73. Other listings fall in between.

etchant_ferric_per_l.note: Bulk gallons are about $9 to $12 per liter (Takach, 4 gallons for $140). A 1 liter bottle is about $18. Small bottles cost more, up to $47 per liter. Etchant can be reused, so the per-board use is conservative.

magnet_wire_per_kg.note: Low: a UK per-kg guide, about $26 to $31. High: Elecify's 0.3 mm, 140 g spool at $6.24, about $45 per kg. A DigiKey listing at $136 per kg is about 12 years old and was left out. Low confidence: ask a supplier for a quote on 0.3 mm round wire.

ndfeb_n52_10x2_each.note: JC-Magnetics: $0.26 each at 5,000 or more, $0.30 at 500, $0.46 at 50, and $0.78 at the 25-piece minimum. Small-quantity sellers charge several times more, so buy in bulk or salvage magnets.

stator_steel_core_each.note: Not priced. Steel laminations for a stator core are still open. Options: salvage, a laser-cut lamination stack, or a coreless design. Until this is priced, DIY motor totals are incomplete.
